recommendation: Keep the commit. It fixes active stale guidance without broadening the change into separate cleanup of the legacy standalone ObservationRelationshipTypes value set, which is not bound by current Observation elements or examples.
issue_request: FHIR-7639 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Observation issue asking whether the old ObservationRelationshipType distinction between has component and has member should remain; its final resolution pointed to FHIR-7517.
initial_application: The 2015 implementation was commit 348f096acfd2c65b60b6ba759f214f756d403709, which reintroduced Observation.component, changed Observation examples away from has-component related relationships, and cited FHIR-7639, followed by commit 571342326cf07bc094b7310286c8a51133c1daf5 for text edits. Current Observation source already has separate Observation.hasMember and Observation.component elements, but the active _filter page still had stale related[type eq has-component] examples.
additional_context: FHIR-7517 explicitly removed has-component and restored inline Observation.component. FHIR-10118 later replaced Observation.related with direct elements such as hasMember and derivedFrom. The current source defines the normative Observation-has-member SearchParameter, and source/hierarchy.xml includes search_filter.html in the active RESTful API/Search section.
reconciliation: Changed source/search_filter.html to use Observation: has-member examples instead of Observation.related[type eq has-component] examples.
source_changes: source/search_filter.html: replaced two _filter examples using Observation.related[type eq has-component] with current Observation: has-member reference-search examples.

related_jiras.note: Published issue referenced by FHIR-7639; its motion removed has-component and added Observation.component.
Published later refactor that replaced Observation.related with direct inline relationship elements, reinforcing the source change.
